BiblicalUsage: The wicked swallows down riches, and God casts them out of his belly — he shall vomit them up again. And the LORD speaks to the fish, and it vomits Jonah out upon the dry land. The word is the vomiting itself.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe riches swallowed down come back up, and the fish that swallowed Jonah gave him back on dry land.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
